name: verdict-reader
why: Section 5's verdict, read from a PR's raw reviews by the one reader every surface calls: the inbox sweep, the merge helper, and any reader in another runtime. Each case gives the PR's author, the identity that would merge, and the reviews oldest first; it expects the verdict word and the index in `reviews` of the review that decided it (null when awaiting), because a re-drive over a FAIL takes that review's findings as its work order. The cases pin the vocabulary (the last token, its casing and emphasis, the one-object rule) and the three rules on who records: a review counts only from the repo's owner, a member of its organisation or a collaborator, a review by the PR's author or the merger is UNRECORDED, and UNRECORDED never outranks a counted verdict.

cases.name: no-review
cases.why: Nothing reviewed is awaiting, and no review decided it.

cases.name: approved-pass
cases.why: The authoritative record: an approving review whose last token is PASS, from a member who is neither the author nor the merger.

reviews.body:
Read against the ticket and the CI run.

VERDICT: PASS

cases.name: emphasis-and-trailing-prose
cases.why: The token is read wherever it lands: markdown emphasis around it and prose after it change nothing. A collaborator can write to the repo, so the review counts.

reviews.body:
No findings.

**VERDICT: PASS**

CI is green on the head commit.

cases.name: last-token-in-the-body
cases.why: A body that mentions an earlier verdict is read by its last token. An owner can write to the repo, so the review counts.

reviews.body:
The first read ended VERDICT: FAIL; the fix landed and the finding is gone.

VERDICT: PASS

cases.name: counted-fail-in-any-casing
cases.why: A request-changes review written `Verdict: FAIL` is a counted FAIL: the token is read in any casing, and this review is the work order.

reviews.body:
1. The link is relative to the wrong base.

Verdict: FAIL

cases.name: approval-without-a-token
cases.why: An approval with no verdict token is not a verdict.

cases.name: pass-in-a-plain-comment
cases.why: One object carries both the state and the verdict: a PASS token on a commented review is not a verdict.

cases.name: pass-on-a-request-changes-review
cases.why: A PASS counts only on an approving review; a request-changes review carrying PASS records nothing, so nothing merges on it.

cases.name: a-later-fail-stands-over-an-earlier-pass
cases.why: The last counted verdict decides, whoever wrote the earlier one.

reviews.body:
1. The migration drops a column still read.

VERDICT: FAIL

cases.name: a-later-pass-stands-over-an-earlier-fail
cases.why: A fresh PASS after the findings are resolved decides.

reviews.body:
The test is there.

VERDICT: PASS

cases.name: no-repo-association
cases.why: A review counts only from the repo's owner, a member of its organisation or a collaborator: on a public repo anyone can post an approving review ending PASS, and it authorizes nothing.

cases.name: no-repo-association-under-a-counted-fail
cases.why: A later PASS from an author with no association to the repo takes no part, so it cannot stand over a counted FAIL.

reviews.body:
1. The secret is logged.

VERDICT: FAIL

Looks fine to me.

VERDICT: PASS

cases.name: association-missing
cases.why: Fail closed: a review that carries no author association counts for nothing.

cases.name: the-authors-own-pass
cases.why: A review by the PR's author is UNRECORDED, never PASS, whatever state the host let it carry.

cases.name: the-mergers-own-fail
cases.why: A review by the identity that would merge is UNRECORDED, never FAIL.

cases.name: the-authors-unrecorded
cases.why: The third state as section 5 defines it: the author's own analysis, posted as a commented review ending UNRECORDED.

reviews.body:
No findings; CI green.

VERDICT: UNRECORDED

cases.name: an-authors-reply-without-a-token
cases.why: Only a review bearing a token takes part: the author's reply on a review thread is not an UNRECORDED verdict.

cases.name: unrecorded-never-outranks-a-counted-pass
cases.why: A newer review whose last token is UNRECORDED records nothing, even on an approving review, so the counted PASS before it still decides.

cases.name: the-mergers-pass-after-a-counted-pass
cases.why: The merger's own approving PASS after an independent PASS records nothing, so the independent PASS still decides.

cases.name: a-fail-on-an-approving-review
cases.why: A FAIL counts on an approving review as well as on a request-changes one: the token is the verdict.

reviews.body:
1. The migration drops a column.

VERDICT: FAIL

cases.name: an-authors-unrecorded-quoting-fail
cases.why: A newer review by the author that quotes `VERDICT: FAIL` as its last token is still UNRECORDED: the counted FAIL before it decides, and its findings, not the author's, are the work order.

reviews.body:
1. The retry never backs off.

Verdict: FAIL

VERDICT: UNRECORDED

The review before this one ended `VERDICT: FAIL`, and its finding stands.

cases.name: a-real-pass-supersedes-an-earlier-unrecorded
cases.why: UNRECORDED holds the place of an absent verdict, so a counted PASS arriving after it decides.

cases.name: the-latest-unrecorded-decides-among-them
cases.why: With no counted verdict, the last review that recorded nothing is the one that decided.
